author: NASS
description:
Travel back to 1950s Portugal and experience the country's timeless beauty through rare historical footage restored in stunning 4K 60fps. From charming whitewashed villages and Lisbon's iconic yellow trams to traditional fishing boats, steam trains, vineyards, and breathtaking Mediterranean landscapes, every scene has been carefully restored using my latest restoration and semantic colorization techniques.
 If you enjoy historical restorations, don't forget to Like, Comment, and Subscribe for more journeys through history.

📽️ Technologies & Techniques Used:
• Advanced video restoration
• New semantic colorization only for the ambiance (not historically accurate)
• Manually colorized keyframes (to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
• Advanced frame reconstruction to 4K
• Manual color corrections 
• Classical restoration workflows (AviSynth ) combined with modern tools for (60fps, stabilization, denoise, cleaning, and deblurring )
• Sound desi
title: Old Portugal 1950s – Advanced Colorization (4k60fps) with Sound Design
